paper.title_en: Quantum gravity around ultracold black holes from DSSYK
paper.abstract_en: We propose a quantum description of the ultracold Reissner-Nordström de Sitter black hole via a specific flat space limit of the double-scaled SYK model. Fluctuations in this regime reduce to flat JT gravity, which is ill-behaved as a quantum system. We show that including the first subleading correction to the dilaton potential breaks the leading order Hagedorn degeneracy but does not resolve the structural problem. Finally, we leverage the gauged description of the sine dilaton gravity model to propose a novel quantization of the near-horizon dynamics of ultracold black holes. This leads to a new proposal for the partition function where states in the asymptotics of the spectrum are suppressed dynamically, and features of a discretized spacetime arise. We obtain a non-perturbative low temperature behavior of the partition function, which is quite different than the cold and Nariai physics. Our result can be interpreted as a dynamical way to enforce cosmic censorship on the quantum system.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了关于超冷黑洞量子描述的新提案，与广义相对论基础相关，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 来自DSSYK的超冷黑洞周围的量子引力
decision.abstract_zh: 我们通过双标度SYK模型的一个特定平直空间极限，提出了超冷Reissner-Nordström de Sitter黑洞的量子描述。该区域的涨落约化为平直JT引力，其作为量子系统表现不佳。我们表明，包含对膨胀子势的第一个次领头阶修正会打破领头阶的Hagedorn简并，但并不能解决结构性问题。最后，我们利用正弦膨胀子引力模型的规范描述，提出了对超冷黑洞近水平动力学的一种新颖量子化方案。这导致了对配分函数的一个新提议，其中光谱渐近态被动力学抑制，并且出现了离散时空的特征。我们得到了配分函数的非微扰低温行为，这与冷和Nariai物理有很大不同。我们的结果可以被解释为在量子系统上动态地强制执行宇宙审查的一种方式。
